# ankra_secret_slot (Resource)

An organisation secret slot: a value stored by the platform and referenced everywhere else by its marker, `${SECRET_SLOT:<id>}` (the `sentinel` attribute). Use the marker wherever the platform asks for one, such as a secret header of `ankra_mcp_server`, so the value itself never appears in that resource's configuration.

The platform never returns the value, so a value changed outside Terraform is not detected, and an imported slot plans one value write. Changing `value` replaces it in place, keeping the id and marker; changing `label` or `hint` replaces the slot. A slot that a live resource still references cannot be deleted: destroy fails with a 409 until the reference is removed. Slots created here never expire.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "github_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "ankra_secret_slot" "github" {
  label = "github-mcp-token"
  value = var.github_token
  hint  = "Read-only GitHub token for the GitHub MCP server"
}

# Reference the slot by its marker; the value never appears in the MCP
# server's configuration.
output "github_token_marker" {
  value = ankra_secret_slot.github.sentinel
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Label of the slot, unique in the organisation; at most 120 characters, without newlines or tabs. Changing it replaces the slot.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret value, at most 64 KiB. It is stored in Terraform state, as every sensitive value is; protect the state accordingly.

### Optional

- `hint` (String) A note shown next to the slot, at most 240 characters. Changing it replaces the slot.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the slot was created.
- `created_via` (String) `user` for a slot holding a given value, `generated` for one the platform generated.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the slot.
- `pinned_at` (String) When a resource first referenced the slot; null while nothing has.
- `sentinel` (String) The marker to use in place of the value, `${SECRET_SLOT:<id>}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by slot id. The value cannot be read back, so the next apply writes
# the configured value once.
terraform import ankra_secret_slot.github 5107a000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
